title: OEDS synPRO Load Profiles
description: Synthetic household load profiles from Fraunhofer ISE synPRO: electricity of 4 households, space heating and hot water of 4 buildings, 15 minute resolution, one year (2021).

list.name: el
list.label: Electric profile
list.query: Family (2 adults, 2 children) : family,2 full-time employees : two_fulltime_employees,2 persons over 65 : two_persons_over_65,Single person under 30 : single_person_under_30

list.name: building
list.label: Building
list.query: SFH old (1979-2001) : old_single_family_house,SFH passive : passive_single_family_house,MFH old (1979-2001) : old_multi_party_house,MFH passive : passive_multi_party_house

panels.title: synpro tables
panels.description: First and latest timestamp of a profile table and its rows. 12 tables with 35,040 quarter hours each (one year). Static dataset without live updates.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(epoch from min(datetime))*1000)::bigint as "First", (extract(epoch from max(datetime))*1000)::bigint as "Latest", approximate_row_count('synpro.electric_family'::regclass) as "Rows (approx.)"
FROM synpro.electric_family

panels.title: Annual energy per profile
panels.description: Energy (sum x 0.25 h), mean and peak power of all 12 profiles in the selected range. Electric: P_el, heat: Q_htg space heating, hot water: Q_dhw. An old single-family house needs ~26 MWh/a for space heating, a passive house ~3 MWh/a.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT type AS "Type", name AS "Profile", sum(v)*0.25/1000 AS "Energy (kWh)", avg(v) AS "Mean (W)", max(v) AS "Peak (W)", 100.0*avg(v)/NULLIF(max(v), 0) AS "Load factor (%)" FROM (SELECT 'Electricity' AS type, * FROM (SELECT datetime, 'Family (2 adults, 2 children)' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_family
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 full-time employees' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_fulltime_employees
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 persons over 65' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_persons_over_65
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'Single person under 30' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_single_person_under_30) a UNION ALL SELECT 'Space heating', * FROM (SELECT datetime, 'SFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_old_single_family_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'SFH passive' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_passive_single_family_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'MFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_old_multi_party_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'MFH passive' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_passive_multi_party_house) b UNION ALL SELECT 'Hot water', * FROM (SELECT datetime, 'SFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_dhw" AS v FROM synpro.domestic_hot_water_old_single_family_house UNION ALL SELECT datetime, 'SFH passive' AS name, "Q_dhw" AS v FROM synpro.domestic_hot_water_passive_single_family_house UNION ALL SELECT datetime, 'MFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_dhw" AS v FROM synpro.domestic_hot_water_old_multi_party_house UNION ALL SELECT datetime, 'MFH passive' AS name, "Q_dhw" AS v FROM synpro.domestic_hot_water_passive_multi_party_house) c) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Electric load profiles
panels.description: Synthetic data (not measured): profiles from the synPRO model, in W per household/building at 15 minute resolution. Mean power per time bin. The family has the highest consumption, the single person the lowest.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(datetime,$__interval), name, avg(v) AS "P_el" FROM (SELECT datetime, 'Family (2 adults, 2 children)' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_family
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 full-time employees' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_fulltime_employees
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 persons over 65' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_persons_over_65
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'Single person under 30' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_single_person_under_30) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekday profile (local time)
panels.description: Mean power by quarter hour of the day (Europe/Berlin), Monday-Friday. Evening peak around 19-21 h for all households; the family also has a pronounced midday consumption, while the full-time employees are low during the day and the single person has the lowest, flattest profile.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(hour from datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')*4 + floor(extract(minute from datetime)/15))/4.0 AS "Hour of day", avg(v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'Family (2 adults, 2 children)') AS "Family (2 adults, 2 children)", avg(v) FILTER (WHERE name = '2 full-time employees') AS "2 full-time employees", avg(v) FILTER (WHERE name = '2 persons over 65') AS "2 persons over 65", avg(v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'Single person under 30') AS "Single person under 30" FROM (SELECT datetime, 'Family (2 adults, 2 children)' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_family
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 full-time employees' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_fulltime_employees
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 persons over 65' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_persons_over_65
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'Single person under 30' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_single_person_under_30) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) AND extract(isodow from datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') < 6 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Weekend profile (local time)
panels.description: Mean power by quarter hour of the day (Europe/Berlin), Saturday and Sunday: the full-time employees are at home during the day, so their midday consumption rises compared to weekdays.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(hour from datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')*4 + floor(extract(minute from datetime)/15))/4.0 AS "Hour of day", avg(v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'Family (2 adults, 2 children)') AS "Family (2 adults, 2 children)", avg(v) FILTER (WHERE name = '2 full-time employees') AS "2 full-time employees", avg(v) FILTER (WHERE name = '2 persons over 65') AS "2 persons over 65", avg(v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'Single person under 30') AS "Single person under 30" FROM (SELECT datetime, 'Family (2 adults, 2 children)' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_family
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 full-time employees' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_fulltime_employees
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 persons over 65' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_persons_over_65
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'Single person under 30' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_single_person_under_30) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) AND extract(isodow from datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') >= 6 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly electricity consumption
panels.description: Energy per month (kWh) of the four electric profiles. The synthetic profiles are almost flat over the year with slightly more consumption in winter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month", sum(v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'Family (2 adults, 2 children)')*0.25/1000 AS "Family (2 adults, 2 children)", sum(v) FILTER (WHERE name = '2 full-time employees')*0.25/1000 AS "2 full-time employees", sum(v) FILTER (WHERE name = '2 persons over 65')*0.25/1000 AS "2 persons over 65", sum(v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'Single person under 30')*0.25/1000 AS "Single person under 30" FROM (SELECT datetime, 'Family (2 adults, 2 children)' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_family
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 full-time employees' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_fulltime_employees
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 persons over 65' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_persons_over_65
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'Single person under 30' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_single_person_under_30) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Load duration curves of the electric profiles
panels.description: Power sorted from highest to lowest: x is the share of time in which the power is exceeded. Short high peaks (cooking, water heating) over a low base load.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (1-i/50.0)*100 AS "Share of time exceeded (%)", percentile_cont(i/50.0) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'Family (2 adults, 2 children)') AS "Family (2 adults, 2 children)", percentile_cont(i/50.0) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FILTER (WHERE name = '2 full-time employees') AS "2 full-time employees", percentile_cont(i/50.0) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FILTER (WHERE name = '2 persons over 65') AS "2 persons over 65", percentile_cont(i/50.0) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'Single person under 30') AS "Single person under 30" FROM (SELECT datetime, 'Family (2 adults, 2 children)' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_family
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 full-time employees' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_fulltime_employees
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, '2 persons over 65' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_two_persons_over_65
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'Single person under 30' AS name, "P_el" AS v FROM synpro.electric_single_person_under_30) x, generate_series(0,50) i WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY i ORDER BY i DESC

panels.title: Heating and hot water of the buildings
Space heating demand
panels.description: Synthetic data (not measured): profiles from the synPRO model, in W per household/building at 15 minute resolution. Daily mean heating power per building (W). Old buildings (1979-2001) need 4-8 times more heat than passive houses; demand follows the heating season.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(datetime,'1d'), name, avg(v) AS "Q_htg" FROM (SELECT datetime, 'SFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_old_single_family_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'SFH passive' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_passive_single_family_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'MFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_old_multi_party_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'MFH passive' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_passive_multi_party_house) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly space heating energy
panels.description: Space heating energy per month (kWh) of the four buildings.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin'), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month", sum(v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'SFH old (1979-2001)')*0.25/1000 AS "SFH old (1979-2001)", sum(v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'SFH passive')*0.25/1000 AS "SFH passive", sum(v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'MFH old (1979-2001)')*0.25/1000 AS "MFH old (1979-2001)", sum(v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'MFH passive')*0.25/1000 AS "MFH passive" FROM (SELECT datetime, 'SFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_old_single_family_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'SFH passive' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_passive_single_family_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'MFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_old_multi_party_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'MFH passive' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_passive_multi_party_house) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Domestic hot water demand
panels.description: Daily mean hot water heat demand per building (W): moderately seasonal (about 40 % higher in winter than in August) and independent of the insulation standard; roughly twice as large for multi-family houses.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(datetime,'1d'), name, avg(v) AS "Q_dhw" FROM (SELECT datetime, 'SFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_dhw" AS v FROM synpro.domestic_hot_water_old_single_family_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'SFH passive' AS name, "Q_dhw" AS v FROM synpro.domestic_hot_water_passive_single_family_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'MFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_dhw" AS v FROM synpro.domestic_hot_water_old_multi_party_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'MFH passive' AS name, "Q_dhw" AS v FROM synpro.domestic_hot_water_passive_multi_party_house) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Heat duration curves
panels.description: Space heating power sorted from highest to lowest: the peak defines the required heat generator size, many hours are at low load. Peaks: old buildings 13-26 kW, passive houses 6-16 kW.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (1-i/50.0)*100 AS "Share of time exceeded (%)", percentile_cont(i/50.0) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'SFH old (1979-2001)') AS "SFH old (1979-2001)", percentile_cont(i/50.0) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'SFH passive') AS "SFH passive", percentile_cont(i/50.0) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'MFH old (1979-2001)') AS "MFH old (1979-2001)", percentile_cont(i/50.0) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY v) FILTER (WHERE name = 'MFH passive') AS "MFH passive" FROM (SELECT datetime, 'SFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_old_single_family_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'SFH passive' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_passive_single_family_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'MFH old (1979-2001)' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_old_multi_party_house
UNION ALL
SELECT datetime, 'MFH passive' AS name, "Q_htg" AS v FROM synpro.heat_passive_multi_party_house) x, generate_series(0,50) i WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY i ORDER BY i DESC

panels.title: Electricity and heat demand of the selected household
panels.description: Selected electric profile plus space heating and hot water of the selected building (W, daily mean). Recommended combinations (dataset description): family with any single-family house, all electric profiles together with a multi-family house.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(datetime,'1d'), avg("P_el") AS "Electricity", avg("Q_htg") AS "Space heating", avg("Q_dhw") AS "Hot water" FROM (SELECT e.datetime, e."P_el", h."Q_htg", w."Q_dhw" FROM synpro.electric_${el} e JOIN synpro.heat_${building} h USING (datetime) JOIN synpro.domestic_hot_water_${building} w USING (datetime)) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Annual energy of the combination
panels.description: Energy in the selected range for the selected electric profile and building.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum("P_el")*0.25/1000 AS "Electricity", sum("Q_htg")*0.25/1000 AS "Space heating", sum("Q_dhw")*0.25/1000 AS "Hot water", 100.0*sum("Q_dhw" + "Q_htg")/NULLIF(sum("Q_dhw" + "Q_htg" + "P_el"), 0) AS "Heat share" FROM (SELECT e.datetime, e."P_el", h."Q_htg", w."Q_dhw" FROM synpro.electric_${el} e JOIN synpro.heat_${building} h USING (datetime) JOIN synpro.domestic_hot_water_${building} w USING (datetime)) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime)

panels.title: Winter vs summer day of the combination
panels.description: Mean power by hour of the day (Europe/Berlin) of the selected electricity profile and hot water in January and July, and space heating in January: heating and hot water peaks coincide with the electricity peaks in the morning and evening.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (extract(hour from datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')*4 + floor(extract(minute from datetime)/15))/4.0 AS "Hour of day", avg("P_el") FILTER (WHERE extract(month from datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 1) AS "Electricity Jan", avg("P_el") FILTER (WHERE extract(month from datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 7) AS "Electricity Jul", avg("Q_htg") FILTER (WHERE extract(month from datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 1) AS "Space heating Jan", avg("Q_dhw") FILTER (WHERE extract(month from datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 1) AS "Hot water Jan", avg("Q_dhw") FILTER (WHERE extract(month from datetime AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') = 7) AS "Hot water Jul" FROM (SELECT e.datetime, e."P_el", h."Q_htg", w."Q_dhw" FROM synpro.electric_${el} e JOIN synpro.heat_${building} h USING (datetime) JOIN synpro.domestic_hot_water_${building} w USING (datetime)) x WHERE $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
